roadmap.title: Build the Ranch and advance cumulative counters
roadmap.description: Establish food production and corrals, sell every spare plort, and complete the easy feeding, income, garden, timing, and daily-routine achievements during normal ranch work.

roadmap.title: Explore the Range and finish Adventure Mode
roadmap.description: Burst gordos for Slime Keys, open the Quarry and Moss Blanket, progress through the Ancient Ruins into the Glass Desert, restore an oasis, read Hobson's final note, and trigger the ending.

roadmap.title: Complete ranch, science, 7Zee, and Slimepedia cleanup
roadmap.description: Max the required ranch structures, arrange the population challenges, finish Slime Science counters, raise 7Zee rank for chromas, toys, and snares, and fill every remaining Slimepedia tile.

roadmap.title: Earn 75,000 points in Rush Mode
roadmap.description: Use Range Exchanges, Gold Gordos, favorite-fed largos, and broad Plort Bonus coverage to finish one separate Rush run above 75,000 points and unlock all three timed thresholds.

achievements.description: Sell 100 plorts at the Plort Market
achievements.summary: Sell a cumulative total of @mechanic{100 plorts} at the Ranch Plort Market.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative, so ordinary ranch income advances every tier without stockpiling or selling all plorts at once.

steps.text: Vac plorts from collectors, corrals, or the wild and fire them into the @loc{Ranch Plort Market} until the lifetime counter reaches the required total.

achievements.description: Sell 500 plorts at the Plort Market
achievements.summary: Sell a cumulative total of @mechanic{500 plorts} at the Ranch Plort Market.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative, so ordinary ranch income advances every tier without stockpiling or selling all plorts at once.

steps.text: Vac plorts from collectors, corrals, or the wild and fire them into the @loc{Ranch Plort Market} until the lifetime counter reaches the required total.

achievements.description: Sell 1,000 plorts at the Plort Market
achievements.summary: Sell a cumulative total of @mechanic{1,000 plorts} at the Ranch Plort Market.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative, so ordinary ranch income advances every tier without stockpiling or selling all plorts at once.

steps.text: Vac plorts from collectors, corrals, or the wild and fire them into the @loc{Ranch Plort Market} until the lifetime counter reaches the required total.

achievements.description: Sell 2,500 plorts at the Plort Market
achievements.summary: Sell a cumulative total of @mechanic{2,500 plorts} at the Ranch Plort Market.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative, so ordinary ranch income advances every tier without stockpiling or selling all plorts at once.

steps.text: Vac plorts from collectors, corrals, or the wild and fire them into the @loc{Ranch Plort Market} until the lifetime counter reaches the required total.

achievements.description: Sell 5,000 plorts at the Plort Market
achievements.summary: Sell a cumulative total of @mechanic{5,000 plorts} at the Ranch Plort Market.

guide.context: The counter is cumulative, so ordinary ranch income advances every tier without stockpiling or selling all plorts at once.

steps.text: Vac plorts from collectors, corrals, or the wild and fire them into the @loc{Ranch Plort Market} until the lifetime counter reaches the required total.

achievements.description: Feed 100 chickens to slimes on the Ranch
achievements.summary: Have Ranch slimes consume a cumulative @mechanic{100 chickens}.

guide.context: Chickens dispensed by an auto-feeder count, making a meat-eating corral the least labor-intensive route.

steps.text: Raise Hen Hens and Roostros in a Coop, place meat-eating slimes or largos in a Corral, and load chickens into its auto-feeder.
Continue until Ranch slimes have eaten 100 chickens in total.

achievements.description: Have 3 different fruit trees on the Ranch at the same time
achievements.summary: Keep @mechanic{three different fruit crops} growing in Ranch Gardens at the same time.

guide.context: Each Garden must contain a different fruit species; duplicate trees do not increase the type count.

steps.text: Build three Gardens on Ranch plots and plant three distinct fruits, such as @item{Pogofruit}, @item{Cuberry}, and @item{Mint Mango}.
Leave all three fruit trees planted simultaneously until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Have 3 different veggie gardens on the Ranch at the same time
achievements.summary: Keep @mechanic{three different vegetable crops} growing in Ranch Gardens at the same time.

guide.context: The requirement checks distinct planted vegetable species rather than the number of Gardens or harvested vegetables.

steps.text: Build three Gardens and plant different vegetables, such as @item{Carrot}, @item{Heart Beet}, and @item{Oca Oca}.
Keep all three vegetable patches active simultaneously until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Earn over 5,000 newbucks
achievements.summary: Earn a cumulative total of @mechanic{5,000 newbucks} in Adventure Mode.

guide.context: Spending does not erase progress because the achievement tracks total newbucks earned, not the balance currently held.

steps.text: Sell plorts at the @loc{Ranch Plort Market} and complete Range Exchanges until cumulative earnings reach the required total.

achievements.description: Earn over 25,000 newbucks
achievements.summary: Earn a cumulative total of @mechanic{25,000 newbucks} in Adventure Mode.

guide.context: Spending does not erase progress because the achievement tracks total newbucks earned, not the balance currently held.

steps.text: Sell plorts at the @loc{Ranch Plort Market} and complete Range Exchanges until cumulative earnings reach the required total.

achievements.description: Earn over 100,000 newbucks
achievements.summary: Earn a cumulative total of @mechanic{100,000 newbucks} in Adventure Mode.

guide.context: Spending does not erase progress because the achievement tracks total newbucks earned, not the balance currently held.

steps.text: Sell plorts at the @loc{Ranch Plort Market} and complete Range Exchanges until cumulative earnings reach the required total.

achievements.description: Earn 5,000 newbucks in a single day
achievements.summary: Earn @mechanic{5,000 newbucks} between one 6:00 a.m. rollover and the next.

guide.context: A Silo lets you prepare the required value beforehand; only the sales need to occur during the same in-game day.

steps.text: Store enough valuable plorts to be worth at least 5,000 newbucks at current market prices.
Immediately after 6:00 a.m., sell the stockpile at the Ranch Plort Market before the next 6:00 a.m. rollover.

achievements.description: Stay awake from 6 AM to 6 AM the next day
achievements.summary: Stay awake continuously from @mechanic{6:00 a.m. until the following 6:00 a.m.}.

guide.context: Sleeping or using the house's Return to Ranch option breaks the full-day awake interval.

steps.text: Begin just after the morning clock passes 6:00 a.m. and continue ranching or exploring without sleeping.
Remain awake when the clock reaches 6:00 a.m. on the next day.

achievements.description: Be knocked out before 10 AM
achievements.summary: Get knocked out after @mechanic{6:00 a.m. but before 10:00 a.m.}.

guide.context: Falling into the Slime Sea causes an immediate knockout and is more reliable than waiting for hostile damage.

steps.text: Leave the Ranch after 6:00 a.m., walk off a shoreline into the @loc{Slime Sea}, and let the knockout occur before 10:00 a.m.

achievements.description: Return to the Ranch after more than 24 hours
achievements.summary: Return to the Ranch after spending more than @mechanic{24 in-game hours} away from it.

guide.context: Crossing the Ranch boundary too early resets the absence, so remain in the wild through a full day-night cycle.

steps.text: Leave the Ranch and explore another region without returning for more than 24 in-game hours.
Cross back into the Ranch after the full absence to trigger the achievement.

achievements.description: Shoot food into an airborne slime's mouth
achievements.summary: Shoot food into a slime's mouth while that slime is airborne.

guide.context: A Pink Slime is convenient because it accepts every food category and can be carried to an open Ranch plot.

steps.text: Vac a @enemy{Pink Slime}, aim upward, and launch it into the air.
While the Pink Slime is still falling, fire a @item{Carrot} or other food directly into its mouth.

achievements.description: Feed pink slimes on the Ranch 10 different types of food
achievements.summary: Feed @enemy{Pink Slimes} @mechanic{10 different food types} on the Ranch.

guide.context: Pink Slimes eat fruit, vegetables, and meat, so use ten distinct species rather than ten copies of one food.

steps.text: Keep Pink Slimes in a Ranch Corral and gather ten differently named foods across all three categories.
Feed each distinct food type to a Pink Slime in that Ranch Corral until ten types have been eaten.

achievements.description: Feed 50 slimes on the Ranch their favorite food
achievements.summary: Feed Ranch slimes their favorite foods @mechanic{50 times} in total.

guide.context: An auto-feeder counts and a favorite meal produces double plorts, which makes the counter easy to combine with routine ranch income.

steps.text: Place a slime or largo in a Corral and load its listed favorite food into the auto-feeder.
Keep the corral supplied until Ranch slimes have eaten 50 favorite meals.

achievements.description: Discovered the Quarry
achievements.summary: Pass through the Slime Gate into @loc{The Indigo Quarry}.

guide.context: The Quarry is one of the two early regions opened with a Slime Key from a Gordo.

steps.text: Take a Slime Key to the Dry Reef gate marked by the rocky Quarry route.
Open the gate and continue until the Indigo Quarry area name appears.

achievements.description: Discovered the Moss Blanket
achievements.summary: Pass through the Slime Gate into @loc{The Moss Blanket}.

guide.context: The Moss Blanket entrance branches from the Dry Reef and requires its own Slime Key if the Quarry was opened first.

steps.text: Burst another Gordo for a Slime Key, open the gate on the overgrown Dry Reef route, and enter the Moss Blanket.

achievements.description: Discovered the Glass Desert
achievements.summary: Activate the portal at the back of @loc{The Ancient Ruins} and enter @loc{The Glass Desert}.

guide.context: The portal chamber requires a Slime Key to reach and five Quantum Plorts to power its statues.

steps.text: Carry one Slime Key and five @item{Quantum Plorts} through the Ancient Ruins to the rear portal chamber.
Open the final gate, load all five Quantum Plorts into the statues, and walk through the activated portal.

achievements.description: Burst a gordo slime
achievements.summary: Feed any Gordo until it bursts into smaller slimes.

guide.context: The starting Pink Gordo in the Dry Reef accepts every food and bursts after 30 ordinary foods, making it the earliest option.

steps.text: Locate the @enemy{Pink Gordo} on the island reached from the opening Dry Reef paths.
Feed it 30 fruits, vegetables, or chickens until it bursts and drops a Slime Key.

achievements.description: Open a slime gate
achievements.summary: Use a @item{Slime Key} to open any locked Slime Gate.

guide.context: Bursting a Gordo is the normal early source of a Slime Key, and either the Indigo Quarry or Moss Blanket gate qualifies.

steps.text: Collect the Slime Key dropped by a burst Gordo.
Interact with a locked Slime Gate and spend the key to open it.

achievements.description: Incinerate an elder chicken
achievements.summary: Burn an @item{Elder Hen} or @item{Elder Roostro} in an Incinerator.

guide.context: Chickens eventually become elders after producing enough chicks; an Incinerator burns any item fired into its intake.

steps.text: Build an Incinerator, wait for a Coop chicken to become an Elder Hen or Elder Roostro, and vac the elder bird.
Fire the elder chicken into the Incinerator opening.

achievements.description: Send an adorable chick to a fiery end, the same place you're now destined to go
achievements.summary: Burn a living @item{Chickadoo} in an Incinerator.

guide.context: A Chickadoo must be used; an adult Hen Hen or Roostro does not satisfy this separate condition.

steps.text: Collect a Chickadoo from a Coop or wild nest and fire it into a built Incinerator.

achievements.description: Put at least 50 units into each slot of a fully upgraded silo
achievements.summary: Put at least @mechanic{50 items in every one of the 12 slots} of a fully upgraded Silo.

guide.context: All three Silo upgrades are required before the structure has twelve storage slots, and each slot is checked separately.

steps.text: Build a Silo and purchase all three Storage upgrades.
Fill each of the twelve slots with a stack of at least 50 identical items; different slots may hold different resources.

achievements.description: Have a maximally upgraded corral, coop, and silo on the Ranch
achievements.summary: Own a fully upgraded Corral, Coop, Silo, and Garden, including Mochi's Deluxe Coop and Ogden's two Garden upgrades.

guide.context: Current builds also count the later side-activity plot upgrades, so the base terminal purchases alone may not trigger the achievement.

steps.text: Unlock Mochi's Manor, finish her Nimble Valley reward track for the Deluxe Coop upgrade, and install that upgrade on a Coop.
Unlock Ogden's Retreat, finish his Wilds reward track, and install Miracle Mix and the Deluxe Garden upgrade on a Garden.
Build a Corral and Silo, then buy every listed upgrade for the Corral, Coop, Silo, and Garden until the achievement registers.

achievements.description: Fulfill a Range Exchange request between Noon and 2 PM
achievements.summary: Complete a Range Exchange request between @mechanic{12:00 p.m. and 2:00 p.m.}.

guide.context: Prepare the requested items before noon so travel or gathering does not push the delivery beyond the two-hour window.

steps.text: Accept a Range Exchange request, collect every requested item, and wait beside the exchange terminal until noon.
Deposit the complete order after 12:00 p.m. and before 2:00 p.m.

achievements.description: Collect 50 plorts on the Range in a single day
achievements.summary: Collect @mechanic{50 plorts in the Range} during one in-game day.

guide.context: Plorts produced on the Ranch do not count; favorite foods double output and largos can produce two plort types per meal.

steps.text: After the 6:00 a.m. rollover, carry favorite foods into the Range and feed wild slimes or largos.
Vac 50 newly produced wild plorts before the next 6:00 a.m. rollover.

achievements.description: Obtain at least 3 gold plorts from a single gold slime
achievements.summary: Make one @enemy{Gold Slime} produce at least @mechanic{three Gold Plorts} before it escapes.

guide.context: The reliable late-game method is Golden Sureshot from 7Zee rank 22; the Moss Blanket vault supplies controlled Gold Slime encounters after Adventure completion.

steps.text: Reach @mechanic{7Zee rank 22: Endless Mountain III} by paying 456,500 cumulative newbucks, and finish Adventure Mode to unlock Hobson's vaults.
Enter the vault on the Moss Blanket's Feral Path with fruit or vegetables ready.
Hit one spawned Gold Slime with food while Golden Sureshot is active and collect at least three Gold Plorts from that slime.

achievements.displayName: That Only Works in Comic Books
achievements.description: Stand inside a rad aura for at least 15 seconds
achievements.summary: Stay inside one @enemy{Rad Slime's aura} continuously for @mechanic{15 seconds}.

guide.context: A single Rad largo has a larger aura and avoids the lethal overlap created by a crowd; health upgrades provide extra margin.

steps.text: Create or capture one Rad largo, clear other Rad Slimes away, and stand inside the visible radiation aura.
Remain inside the same aura for 15 uninterrupted seconds without being knocked out.

achievements.description: Hold onto a tarr for 15 seconds
achievements.summary: Hold one @enemy{Tarr} in the vac stream continuously for @mechanic{15 seconds}.

guide.context: Tarr do not spawn in Casual Mode. In Adventure Mode, feeding a largo a plort unlike either of its component types creates one immediately.

steps.text: In Adventure Mode, isolate a largo near fresh water and feed it a third slime type's plort.
Keep the resulting Tarr centered in the vac stream for 15 seconds without releasing or sucking it into the tank.

achievements.description: Let a tabby slime headbutt you right on the nose
achievements.summary: Let a @enemy{Tabby Slime} strike your face with its jumping headbutt.

guide.context: Tabby Slimes telegraph the friendly pounce by wiggling before leaping.

steps.text: Stand face-to-face with a Tabby Slime without vacuuming it and wait for the wiggle animation.
Remain in front of the Tabby until its leap hits your face.

achievements.description: Shoot a boom slime largo into the air that explodes before landing
achievements.summary: Launch a @enemy{Boom Slime} into the air so it explodes before landing.

guide.context: A Boom largo stays airborne longer, and its pulsing flare animation shows that the next explosion is imminent.

steps.text: Vac a Boom largo and wait until it begins the bright pre-explosion flare.
Aim straight upward and launch it high enough that the explosion occurs before it touches the ground.

achievements.description: Constrain more than 15 slimes in your vac stream at once while on the range
achievements.summary: Hold more than @mechanic{15 slimes} in the vac stream at once while outside the Ranch.

guide.context: Full vac slots prevent slimes from entering the tank, allowing the stream to keep a large group suspended together.

steps.text: Outside the Ranch, fill all vac slots and herd at least 16 small slimes into a corner.
Sweep the vac stream across the group until more than 15 slimes are visibly pulled at the same time.

achievements.description: Have at least 6 different types of slimes in the same corral
achievements.summary: Keep @mechanic{six distinct pure slime types} in one Ranch Corral at the same time.

guide.context: Do not feed the mixed group: plorts can turn residents into largos and invalidate the pure-type count.

steps.text: Install High Walls on an empty Corral and place one small slime from each of six different species inside.
Keep all six pure types together until the achievement registers.

achievements.description: Have at least 3 different types of largos in the same corral
achievements.summary: Keep @mechanic{three distinct largo combinations} in one Ranch Corral at the same time.

guide.context: A largo that eats a third, unrelated plort becomes Tarr, so remove loose food and plorts before combining the three types.

steps.text: Create three visibly different largo combinations and place one of each in the same upgraded Corral.
Prevent them from eating plorts until the achievement registers.

achievements.description: Fill a pond on the Ranch with at least 5 different types of slimes
achievements.summary: Keep @mechanic{five distinct slime types} together in a Ranch Pond.

guide.context: Use one Puddle Slime plus four land slime species; the Pond itself satisfies the required Ranch location.

steps.text: Build a Pond and place a Puddle Slime plus four different pure land slime types in the water together.

achievements.description: Have at least 10 types of largos on the Ranch
achievements.summary: Maintain @mechanic{10 unique largo pairings} simultaneously across Ranch plots.

guide.context: The largos may be divided among several Corrals; only the combination count and simultaneous Ranch presence matter.

steps.text: Plan ten unique two-species pairings and create each largo by feeding one pure slime the other species' plort.
House all ten largo combinations across upgraded Ranch Corrals at the same time.

achievements.description: Jump into a corral containing at least 40 slimes
achievements.summary: Enter a Ranch Corral while at least @mechanic{40 slimes} are inside it.

guide.context: High Walls and an Air Net keep the crowd contained while the player crosses the plot boundary.

steps.text: Upgrade an empty Corral with High Walls and an Air Net, then load at least 40 small slimes into it.
Jump or walk into the occupied Corral after all 40 slimes are inside.

achievements.description: Reach at least 10,000 newbucks in Rush Mode
achievements.summary: Finish one Rush Mode run with a final score of at least @mechanic{10,000}.

guide.context: The achievement checks the final score after the Plort Bonus, not newbucks still held. A 75,000-point result unlocks all three Rush thresholds together.

steps.text: Start three-day Rush Mode and complete Range Exchanges; every finished order gives six Gilded Ginger and exactly 12 extra minutes.
Feed three Gilded Ginger to each Gold Gordo, bring many fruits or vegetables, and hit every released Gold Slime; Golden Sureshot makes each hit yield three Gold Plorts.
Maintain valuable vegetarian largos such as Honey-Quantum and Mosaic-Dervish, feed their favorites, and sell their plorts throughout the run.
Before time expires, sell at least 25 of as many distinct plort types as practical for Plort Bonus increments, then let the results screen calculate the final score.

achievements.description: Reach at least 35,000 newbucks in Rush Mode
achievements.summary: Finish one Rush Mode run with a final score of at least @mechanic{35,000}.

guide.context: The achievement checks the final score after the Plort Bonus, not newbucks still held. A 75,000-point result unlocks all three Rush thresholds together.

steps.text: Start three-day Rush Mode and complete Range Exchanges; every finished order gives six Gilded Ginger and exactly 12 extra minutes.
Feed three Gilded Ginger to each Gold Gordo, bring many fruits or vegetables, and hit every released Gold Slime; Golden Sureshot makes each hit yield three Gold Plorts.
Maintain valuable vegetarian largos such as Honey-Quantum and Mosaic-Dervish, feed their favorites, and sell their plorts throughout the run.
Before time expires, sell at least 25 of as many distinct plort types as practical for Plort Bonus increments, then let the results screen calculate the final score.

achievements.description: Reach at least 75,000 newbucks in Rush Mode
achievements.summary: Finish one Rush Mode run with a final score of at least @mechanic{75,000}.

guide.context: The achievement checks the final score after the Plort Bonus, not newbucks still held. A 75,000-point result unlocks all three Rush thresholds together.

steps.text: Start three-day Rush Mode and complete Range Exchanges; every finished order gives six Gilded Ginger and exactly 12 extra minutes.
Feed three Gilded Ginger to each Gold Gordo, bring many fruits or vegetables, and hit every released Gold Slime; Golden Sureshot makes each hit yield three Gold Plorts.
Maintain valuable vegetarian largos such as Honey-Quantum and Mosaic-Dervish, feed their favorites, and sell their plorts throughout the run.
Before time expires, sell at least 25 of as many distinct plort types as practical for Plort Bonus increments, then let the results screen calculate the final score.

achievements.description: Discover the Ancient Ruins
achievements.summary: Open the plort-locked entrance and enter @loc{The Ancient Ruins}.

guide.context: The entrance lies beyond the right-hand route at the bottom of the Moss Blanket drop and uses matching plorts rather than another key at the final door.

steps.text: Reach the Ancient Ruins approach from the Moss Blanket and use a Slime Key on the gate along the route.
Fire each pictured plort into its matching slime statue, then pass through the opened stone door.

achievements.description: Fabricate your first Slime Science gadget
achievements.summary: Fabricate a cumulative total of @mechanic{1 Slime Science gadget}.

guide.context: Fabrication is cumulative and duplicate gadgets count; Novice Drills are an inexpensive choice for the high tiers.

steps.text: Buy the Lab ranch expansion, deposit the listed plorts and resources into the Refinery, and use the Fabricator.
Keep fabricating gadgets, including duplicate Novice Drills if desired, until the total reaches 1.

achievements.description: Fabricate 35 Slime Science gadgets
achievements.summary: Fabricate a cumulative total of @mechanic{35 Slime Science gadgets}.

guide.context: Fabrication is cumulative and duplicate gadgets count; Novice Drills are an inexpensive choice for the high tiers.

steps.text: Buy the Lab ranch expansion, deposit the listed plorts and resources into the Refinery, and use the Fabricator.
Keep fabricating gadgets, including duplicate Novice Drills if desired, until the total reaches 35.

achievements.description: Fabricate 100 Slime Science gadgets
achievements.summary: Fabricate a cumulative total of @mechanic{100 Slime Science gadgets}.

guide.context: Fabrication is cumulative and duplicate gadgets count; Novice Drills are an inexpensive choice for the high tiers.

steps.text: Buy the Lab ranch expansion, deposit the listed plorts and resources into the Refinery, and use the Fabricator.
Keep fabricating gadgets, including duplicate Novice Drills if desired, until the total reaches 100.

achievements.description: Place a tarr on the #1 Slime Stage
achievements.summary: Place a @enemy{Tarr} on a deployed @item{Slime Stage} in Adventure Mode.

guide.context: Casual Mode disables Tarr. Creating the Tarr directly on the stage avoids transporting a hostile slime.

steps.text: Fabricate and deploy a Slime Stage, then place a largo on its platform.
Feed the largo a plort from a third slime type so it transforms into a Tarr while standing on the stage.

achievements.description: Score 50 points in a single game of slimeball
achievements.summary: Score @mechanic{50 points in one one-minute game} of Slimeball.

guide.context: Shots made while standing on the hoop's rim may fail to score; a short run-up gives the game a clear crossing trajectory.

steps.text: Fabricate and deploy a Slimeball Hoop, then bring roughly 100 Pink Slimes to its area.
Start the timer, stand a short distance from the hoop, and fire slimes cleanly through it until the score reaches 50.

achievements.description: Join the 7Zee Rewards Club
achievements.summary: Read the Day 7 invitation and join the @mechanic{7Zee Rewards Club} from the Ranch House.

guide.context: The invitation arrives by Starmail at noon on Day 7; membership and later ranks are purchased from the house terminal.

steps.text: After noon on Day 7, enter the Ranch House and read the 7Zee Rewards Club Starmail.
Use the Rewards Club terminal and buy the first membership rank.

achievements.description: Use chroma packs to change the color of the ranch house, tech, and vacpack
achievements.summary: Apply Ranch House, Ranch Tech, and Vacpack chromas from the @mechanic{Chroma Station}.

guide.context: The Chroma Station appears beside the Ranch House at 7Zee rank 5, Skylark I, after 7,750 cumulative newbucks in club payments.

steps.text: Reach 7Zee rank 5 and interact with the Chroma Station next to the Ranch House.
Choose and apply a different appearance setting in each of the @mechanic{Ranch House}, @mechanic{Ranch Tech}, and @mechanic{Vacpack} categories.

achievements.description: Purchase at least 10 different types of slime toys
achievements.summary: Own @mechanic{10 differently named Slime Toys} at the same time.

guide.context: The toy shop unlocks at 7Zee rank 8, Rolling Beetle I; rank 10 adds advanced toys, making ten distinct purchases straightforward.

steps.text: Raise the 7Zee Rewards Club to at least rank 10 by paying 27,750 cumulative newbucks.
Buy ten toys with different names from the Slime Toy shop and keep all ten in the save.

achievements.displayName: The Hunter Has Become... The Other Thing
achievements.description: Snare a Hunter Gordo
achievements.summary: Snare a @enemy{Hunter Gordo} using a @item{Master Gordo Snare} baited with a @item{Roostro}.

guide.context: The Master Gordo Snare is unlocked at 7Zee rank 20, Endless Mountain I, after 291,500 cumulative newbucks in club payments.

steps.text: Reach 7Zee rank 20, fabricate a Master Gordo Snare, and deploy it at any gadget site.
Place a Roostro on the snare, then sleep or pass time and return to the site to find the guaranteed Hunter Gordo.

achievements.description: Start bringing life back to the Glass Desert
achievements.summary: Use @item{Ancient Water} on a dried oasis bud in @loc{The Glass Desert}.

guide.context: Ancient Water lasts only briefly, so activate a fountain near a red oasis bud before collecting it.

steps.text: At a Glass Desert rock fountain, fire three @item{Rock Plorts} into the surrounding statues to start the water.
Vac Ancient Water, hurry to a nearby red oasis bud, and splash the bud once before the water expires.

achievements.description: Complete the Slimepedia
achievements.summary: Discover every required entry shown in the Adventure Mode @mechanic{Slimepedia}.

guide.context: The menu marks undiscovered entries; Twinkle Slime and Party Gordo are excluded. Rare slimes, the three rancher activities, Glass Desert resources, and extractor materials are the usual final gaps.

steps.text: Encounter every required slime form, including Gold, Lucky, Tarr, largos, gordos, Fire, Hunter, Quantum, Dervish, Tangle, Mosaic, Saber, Quicksilver, and Glitch slimes.
Collect every food and resource entry; operate Drills at Quarry and Desert sites, Pumps at Dry Reef and Desert sites, and Apiaries at Moss Blanket and Desert sites for their regional materials.

For Ogden's Retreat, buy the Overgrowth, open the Moss Blanket route, complete an Ogden Range Exchange, and enter The Wilds; feed a Saber Largo and collect its Saber Plort to register the Saber entry, then collect Kookadoba items.
For Mochi's Manor, buy the Grotto, open the Indigo Quarry route, complete a Mochi Range Exchange, enter Nimble Valley, and record Quicksilver Slimes.

For Viktor's Workshop, reach the Ancient Ruins, buy the Lab, fabricate 40 gadgets, purchase Treasure Cracker MKII, and complete a Viktor Range Exchange; enter the Slimeulation to capture a Glitch Slime and trade Bug Reports for a Manifold Cube.
Obtain a Phase Lemon by swapping another fruit at a mature Ancient Ruins tree.
Open Slimepedia, inspect every category for a remaining question-mark tile, and discover each missing entry until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Discover where Hobson's journey ended, and started once again.
achievements.summary: Read @npc{Hobson's final note} at the far end of @loc{The Glass Desert}.

guide.context: The last note is in the rear section beyond another Slime Gate, inside the inactive portal structure.

steps.text: Bring a Slime Key through the Glass Desert and climb to the gate near the area's far end.
Open the gate, enter the portal structure behind it, and read Hobson's final message.

achievements.description: Complete Adventure Mode and set out for what's next.
achievements.summary: Read the final @npc{Casey} Starmail after Hobson's last note, then leave the Ranch House to finish Adventure Mode.

guide.context: The final mail arrives about one or two in-game days after reading Hobson's last message; sleeping advances the wait safely.

steps.text: After reading Hobson's final Glass Desert note, return to the Ranch and sleep until the last Casey Starmail appears.
Read the mail inside the Ranch House, exit the house, and watch the ending cinematic through the achievement unlock.
